Name: HireKey
Tagline: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search
Description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

Name: kōdlo
Tagline: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context
Description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

Name: OpenScreen 2
Tagline: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits
Description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

Name: Agibot
Tagline: Personal AI agent for your Mac using your own keys
Description: Agibot is an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your Mac. It keeps working in the background, even after you close the window. It can send you a morning brief, keep an eye on things and tell you when something changes, and handle tasks on the web for you. Chat with it in the app, on Telegram or on Slack. It remembers what you tell it, learns from your corrections and asks before doing anything risky. Free forever with your own API key.

Name: Ghost Core
Tagline: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device
Description: Ghost Core is a personal AI computer that runs AI models on-device, connects to your apps, files, and devices, and builds continuous context to proactively help you.

Name: Tori
Tagline: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences
Description: One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

Name: Kooler
Tagline: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar
Description: Kooler is a free cocktail recipe app for people who like making drinks at home. - My Bar: add the bottles and ingredients you have and see every drink you can make right now - 100+ curated recipes: classics, modern cocktails and Brazilian drinks like Caipirinha, Rabo de Galo and Macunaíma - Clear measurements, step-by-step methods and consistent photos - Check-ins: rate a drink you had at a bar and share it No ads, no paywall. Web + iOS.

Name: Gboard Kurukuru Version
Tagline: Your fingers stay put. The keys come around
Description: Gboard Kurukuru Version is a conveyor belt keyboard from Google Japan's Gboard team, its 15th. Four belts carry 29 keys each past your fingers, so one hand can reach every character. It isn't for sale, but STL files, firmware and a build guide are on GitHub.

Name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
Tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
Description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

Name: MePersona
Tagline: Answer every fan comment in your voice
Topics: Messaging, Marketing automation, Social media marketing
Description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

Name: FloorGen
Tagline: Draw the house, or just ask. Free floor plans with AI
Description: Plan a remodel, an ADU or a whole house for free in your browser. Describe it and FloorGen AI builds it, every change an undo step. Then check it against the IRC, walk through it in 3D and print the plan set. Claude and ChatGPT can edit it too.

Name: Ayven
Tagline: Carries and drives your team's agenda
Description: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

Name: FocusWrite
Tagline: A local-first writing app with focus modes.
Description: A calm, local-first writing app with deep focus, ambient sounds, optional cloud sync, and PDF export.

Name: Edgee Mod for Claude Code
Tagline: Use any model inside Claude Code, keep your Claude plan
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: A Claude Code mod that puts Edgee in your terminal. Keep your Claude plan, switch your session to any of 200+ models in one keystroke, and see live what compression and routing save you. Same conversation, same context. Two commands to install.

Name: Foley
Tagline: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
Description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

Name: Halo
Tagline: Notifications, dictation and AI agents in your Mac's notch
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Halo turns your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island: messages from any app, dictation that types anywhere when you hold Fn, a little face that follows your cursor and watches your AI agents, plus music, calls and monitor brightness. $9.99 once.

Name: NewMinecraftServers
Tagline: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection.
Description: NewMinecraftServers helps players find their next Minecraft community and gives server owners tools to grow theirs. Discover Java and Bedrock servers, explore player statistics, and follow activity trends before choosing where to play. Owners can claim and promote their server listing, showcase their community, and access detailed analytics on player counts, uptime, peak activity, and busiest hours -- making it easier to understand their audience and attract new players.

Name: SimpleSpread
Tagline: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet
Description: Ever double click a CSV or XLSX file on your mac and have to wait 30 seconds while Numbers loads? And when it loads it's filled with a ton of crap you don't need? Then I wrote this for you (well mostly me, but you might find it cool too). A small, fast spreadsheet for the Mac, written entirely in Swift. Free and MIT open source with XLSX as the native file format. 156 functions, incremental recalc, Excel-style keyboard editing.

Name: Farol
Tagline: The macOS terminal that shows which coding agent needs you
Topics: Mac, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Farol is a macOS terminal for running Claude Code and Codex in parallel. A sidebar shows which agent is working, which is waiting for you and which is done, and the menu bar shows it from any app. Each task gets its own git worktree, started from a prompt, a GitHub issue or a Jira ticket. Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in the same window. Built on libghostty, so it reads your Ghostty config. Free and MIT licensed. No account, no telemetry.

Name: NotchPit
Tagline: Your Mac's notch, rearranged into a control center
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Menu Bar Apps
Description: NotchPit turns the space around your Mac's camera into a control center: music with synced lyrics, prayer times with adhan, your next meeting, and 64 extensions from uptime checks to revenue. Drag, resize and swipe them into your own layout. Try it free for 14 days, then buy once and keep it for life.
